name: 95368 · Salida, CA
findings: ZIP 95368 (Salida) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95368 (Salida) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95368 (Salida) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
